sources.title: LEAP Lab @ Tsinghua University | Machine Learning & AI Research
sources.snippet: The Learning And Perception (LEAP) Lab at Tsinghua University conducts cutting-edge research in machine learning, multi-modal learning, and embodied intelligence. We focus on developing robust, scalable, and generalizable foundation models for the next generation of artificial intelligence.

sources.title: LEAP-LAB-KUS/leap-kt-dkvmn · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Part of leap-kt-toolkit, a systematic re-implementation of published Knowledge Tracing models under one protocol. This repository holds every fold of every dataset this model has been run on, with the per-epoch training logs and the exact user split alongside the checkpoints.

sources.title: LivermorE AI Projector for Computed Tomography (LEAP)
sources.snippet: LivermorE AI Projector for Computed Tomography (LEAP) This is a C++/CUDA library (Linux, Windows, and Mac*) of 3D tomographic algorithms (pre-processing algorithms, projectors, and analytic (FBP) and iterative reconstruction algorithms) with a Python interface.
